payload.title: Post state machine and publishing rounds (ADR 0009)
payload.context: M3 needs a single definition of post states, of who may approve, and of how publishing stays idempotent. See docs/adr/0009-post-state-machine.md.
payload.rationale: The post is the unit of state and approval; variants only record outcomes. Transitions are conditional updates on the model; only ApprovePost calls approve(). Each claim starts a publish round and each job step runs once, so queue retries cannot re-send. A variant keeps an outcome-unknown mark from before the platform call until a recorded publish or a definite refusal. fetchMetrics is deferred to M6.
payload.consequences: Partial success leaves the post failed with published variants kept. A human retry after an unknown outcome can still duplicate a post; closing that needs a platform lookup in M7. The lock store must be shared (redis or database).
